populationIdentity.description: Population is the DEMOGRAPHICS & POPULATION-DYNAMICS domain: birth rates & fertility, mortality & life expectancy, age structure & generational cohorts, migration & immigration, urbanization & settlement patterns, household formation & family structure, dependency ratios, and social structure & inequality. DISTINCT from medicine (health outcomes/treatment/mortality causes are a COUPLING, not the substrate), economy (employment rates/wages/labor market are a COUPLING), education (school enrollment/attainment is a COUPLING), and governance (policy/administration is a COUPLING). The observable surface is official demographic statistics, not single-company tickers.
populationIdentity.primaryAnchor: official demographic series: US Census Bureau & American Community Survey (ACS), UN World Population Prospects (WPP), Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) labor-force participation, and Pew Research demographic studies
populationIdentity.secondaryAnchor: demographic-exposed real proxies as population-dynamics health signals (senior-living/housing/migration-exposed issuers) — used as indicator signals, never as the population substrate itself
populationIdentity.prohibited: never use energy/oil/gas/grid/utility content; never treat mortality/health outcomes (medicine), employment/wages (economy), or enrollment/attainment (education) as population identity — those are cross-domain COUPLINGS surfaced via bindings, not the population substrate. Use only real demographic sources; never fabricate.
